The Unsplash Lite Dataset (v1.2.1)
	


The Lite dataset contains all of the same fields as the Full dataset, but is limited to ~25,000 photos.
It can be used for both commercial and non-commercial usage, provided you abide by the terms.
The Unsplash Dataset is made available for research purposes.
It cannot be used to redistribute the images contained within.
To use the Unsplash library in a product, see the Unsplash API.
